text:
Amy_Support: seeing a sudden jump of 502s for HostedAPI in eu1 starting ~09:07UTC. Customers report streaming failures and short requests failing. sample trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d, logs show upstream reset. :eyes:

oncall_jay: can you paste a minimal repro + headers? are these long-streaming or short requests?

Amy_Support: customer reported both. long streaming embed session + a few short text-gen calls. curl sample they gave:

  curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "OpenAI-Model: redwood/gpt-4-small" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate

response: HTTP/2 502
  upstream: "envoy upstream rst" trace-id: trace-0a1b2c3d

infra_tan: I see a correlating spike in proxy egress RSTs around 09:06:40-09:08:30UTC. Early signs point to keepalive/heartbeat mismatch between frontdoor and midfront proxies after the canary that rolled at 09:05 (deploy-bot posted).

deploy-bot: canary rollout started 2026-03-20T09:05:12Z -> service/proxy-midfront v2.4.1 -> 20%

eng_sre_kim: heartbeat mismatch = different ALPN/idle timeout epoch between upstream and downstream. Long-lived h2 streams are getting half-closed by midfront, frontdoor observes RST and returns 502 to client. That matches both streaming and short requests when connection reuse picks an affected socket.

Amy_Support: customer provided server logs showing: 
  "http2: connection closed unexpectedly: GOAWAY"
  "upstream reset: connection reset by peer"

oncall_jay: mitigation suggestions? can we patch in prod quickly?

eng_sre_kim: short term: roll canary back to previous proxy-midfront (v2.4.0) while we validate heartbeat config. If rollback not possible fast, temporary workarounds: 1) disable connection reuse for affected frontdoor pool (drop keepalive) 2) route streaming-heavy tenants to a different proxy pool/region 3) apply a conservative idle timeout on midfront to match frontdoor.

infra_tan: rolling back canary now. kicking off abort on the deployment.

deploy-bot: abort triggered for service/proxy-midfront canary (v2.4.1) at 2026-03-20T09:09:05Z by infra_tan. Canary traffic shifted back to v2.4.0.

Amy_Support: early telemetry after rollback: 502 rate dropped ~85% in 3 minutes. customer confirmed intermittent requests now succeeding. :thumbsup:

customer_ops_rachel: I messaged the impacted tenant and asked for a test window. They sent a fresh curl which now returns 200 for short calls but still saw 1 failed streaming call earlier. We'll verify long-streams over next 15m.

eng_sre_kim: follow-up actions: 
  - root cause: heartbeat/keepalive timeout configuration drift introduced in proxy-midfront v2.4.1 (diff shows default idle_timeout lowered from 90s -> 20s and aggressive GOAWAY on connection edge).
  - owned by infra/proxy team to add e2e regression for long-lived h2 streams and add synthetic streaming test in canary pipeline.
  - add temporary monitoring alert for upstream RST rate per proxy pool and a runbook entry for rollback steps.

infra_tan: creating infra ticket PROXY-9876 for config rollback + regression tests. adding config pin to ensure keepalive parity across frontdoor/midfront/midproxy.

Amy_Support: notes for support thread: summarize customer impact and mitigation, include trace ids (trace-0a1b2c3d, trace-0f9e8d7c), advise customers to retry streaming sessions if they saw GOAWAY.

oncall_jay: excellent. once PROXY-9876 has a timeline, pls share ETA. I'll keep monitoring for any residual 502s in eu1 over the hour.

customer_ops_rachel: tenant confirmed streaming retries succeeded after 09:12UTC. Marking as "customer workaround confirmed".

eng_sre_kim: long term: ensure canary pipeline runs synthetic 5m streaming session with tokenized payloads and verify no GOAWAY/RST. Also add compatibility test for older client-side keepalive behavior.

Amy_Support: thanks team — I'll update ticketing and the customer's support case.

oncall_jay: adding final note: if you see a similar pattern in other regions, follow same rollback cadence. Keep me pinged. :pray:
